notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple solutions issue for all 200 levels. If you encounter any levels where you believe there might still be multiple solutions, please report them in this community thread. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/754240/discussions/0/4361248014262138291/][Link][/url]
[*] Added a sound effect to the sliders in the puzzle generator page.
[*] The puzzle generator page now includes a description and a warning about the possibility of generating puzzles with multiple solutions.
[/list]

I'll be taking a break to dive into pre-production for my next game. I'll still be around to check on things here, but updates for Math Pixels might be less frequent from now on.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented Steam Cloud saving to the game.
[*] Fixed multiple solutions issue in the first 150 levels. The remaining levels will be updated in the next patchs.
[*] Fixed bugs related to the undo button.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple solutions issue in the first 120 levels. The remaining levels will be updated in the next patchs.
[*] You can now add hint cells to random puzzles.
[*] Random puzzles that are 6-cell wide or long no longer display { } in that column or row.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added 'Hint' Feature: This feature automatically pre-fills certain cells at the start of specific levels to guide players and prevent multiple solutions.
[*] A new tutorial for level 26 explains this feature, as it's the first level with hints.
[*] Fixed multiple solutions issue in the first 60 levels.
[*] All levels now accessible in level select after game completion.
[*] Replaced the yellow theme with a more darker yellow theme.
[*] Middle mouse button now activates the lock tool.
[*] Random puzzles now display 'Level Cleared' text upon completion.
[/list]

I'm still working on fixing the issue of multiple solutions in the remaining levels and will be updated in the upcoming patches.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Windowed Mode option.
[*] Added Level Select functionality.
[*] Implemented Random Puzzle Generator.
[*] Added a new achievement related to the puzzle generator.
[*] Fixed bugs related to Reset Level button.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of some levels.
[/list]
